meaning: Away From Keyboard：「暂离键盘」。游戏/聊天中表示人暂时不在，回来时说 back。也泛指「人不在线」的状态。
example: Going afk for 5 mins, grabbing food.

meaning: Good Game：比赛结束时的礼貌用语「打得好」。提前打 gg 则是嘲讽「这局已经赢定了」。变体 ggwp（good game well played）。
example: GG everyone, that was a close match.

meaning: Good Luck Have Fun：开局礼貌用语「祝好运玩得开心」，与结尾的 gg 配套，是游戏圈的握手礼。
example: Match starting — glhf everyone!

meaning: easy 的缩写：「太简单了」。赢了打 ez 是经典嘲讽行为，比脏话更气人。
example: He typed "ez" after winning by one point — instant villain.

meaning: 新手/菜鸟（newbie 的变体）：既可中性指新人，也可嘲讽技术差还不学的人。变体：n00b、nub。
example: Stop blaming the team, you played like a noob.

meaning: what the f***：「搞什么鬼」。表达震惊、困惑、难以置信的万能三字母，语气可轻可重。
example: WTF, the exam got moved to tomorrow?!

meaning: what the hell：wtf 的温和版「搞什么」。想表达震惊又不想爆粗时的安全选择。
example: WTH happened to the group project file?

meaning: for f***'s sake：「我真是服了」。忍无可忍时的爆发式感叹，烦躁浓度比 wtf 更高。
example: FFS, the wifi died during my submission again.

meaning: Rolling On the Floor Laughing：「笑到满地打滚」。比 lol 更夸张的笑，常与 lmao 连用成 roflmao。
example: He sent the wrong meme to the professor — ROFL.

meaning: laughing my f***ing a** off：lmao 的加强版「笑死我了」。笑的强度等级：lol < lmao < lmfao。
example: LMFAO he really wore pajamas to the lecture.

meaning: I don't care：「我不在乎」。冷淡三字母，配句号使用杀伤力翻倍。
example: idc what they think, I'm wearing the costume.

meaning: I don't give a f***：idc 的狠话版「老子完全不在乎」。情绪烈度拉满的摆烂宣言。
example: Final grade posted? idgaf anymore, semester's over.

meaning: In My Humble Opinion：「依我拙见」。imo 的谦虚版，虽然说的人通常并不谦虚。
example: IMHO, the book was way better than the movie.

meaning: For What It's Worth：「不管有没有用，说一句」。补充意见前的免责声明，降低对方的抵触。
example: FWIW, I thought your presentation was the best one.

meaning: If I Recall Correctly：「如果我没记错的话」。给自己的记忆上保险的前缀。
example: IIRC, the deadline is Friday midnight, not Saturday.

meaning: Today I Learned：「今天我学到了」。源自 Reddit 的 r/todayilearned，分享冷知识的标准开头。
example: TIL octopuses have three hearts.

meaning: Explain Like I'm 5：「当我是五岁小孩来解释」。求一个零基础也能懂的大白话解释，源自 Reddit。
example: Can someone ELI5 how blockchain actually works?

meaning: Ask Me Anything：「随便问」。源自 Reddit 的问答活动形式，名人素人都能开，评论区自由提问。
example: I just finished a marathon in costume — AMA.

meaning: Too Long; Didn't Read：「太长不看」。可以是吐槽（这文太长了），更多是好心人给的一句话总结，等于中文的「省流」。
example: TLDR: the meeting is cancelled, enjoy your day.

meaning: In Case You Missed It：「错过的话补一下」。转发旧消息/重要通知时的贴心前缀。
example: ICYMI: the professor posted the exam answers yesterday.

meaning: Not Safe For Work：「上班别点开」。标记含敏感内容的链接/图片，公共场合慎点的警告标签。反义词 SFW。
example: Don't open that link in the library, it's NSFW.

meaning: By The Way：「顺便说一句」。话题转折或补充信息的万能连接词，聊天高频词前三。
example: BTW, did you finish the reading for tomorrow?

meaning: Also Known As：「又名/也就是」。介绍别名、外号或一针见血的本质：「周一，aka 人类受难日」。
example: My roommate, aka the human alarm clock, wakes up at 6 daily.

meaning: Direct Message：「私信」。「DM me」=私聊我；「slide into DMs」=（通常带搭讪意味地）主动私信。
example: Interested in the textbook? DM me for the price.

meaning: 双义：①Original Poster 楼主/发帖人（论坛用法）；②overpowered 强得离谱（游戏用法：这角色太 OP 了）。
example: OP deleted the post right after everyone replied.

meaning: Original Gangster 演变而来：「元老/初代/正宗」。尊称某领域最早的那批人或最原版的东西。
example: She's an OG member of the club, joined day one.

meaning: My Face When：「当××时我的表情」。配表情包使用：mfw the deadline got extended（配狂喜脸）。
example: MFW I see the exam is open-book.

meaning: That Feel(ing) When：「当××时的那种感觉」。表达微妙共鸣情绪的句式，比 mfw 更侧重心情而非表情。
example: TFW you finish the essay at 11:58pm and it's due 11:59.

meaning: Hit Me Up：「联系我/找我」。约人、求搭子、放话有事随时找的轻松邀请。
example: Anyone wants to study together this weekend, hmu.

meaning: What You Doing：「在干嘛」。开聊天的万能起手式；深夜的 wyd 通常别有深意。
example: wyd? wanna grab bubble tea?

meaning: Where You At：「你在哪」。找人/催人的高频缩写，常和 wyd 组成连环夺命问。
example: Movie starts in 10 mins, wya??

meaning: On My Way：「在路上了」。出门标准回复——虽然发这条时很多人还没出门。
example: "Class started!" — "omw" (still in bed).

meaning: I Know, Right?：「就是说啊！」。强烈赞同对方的吐槽或观点，附和界的满分答案。
example: "This weather is insane." — "IKR, it snowed in May."

meaning: of course：「当然」。爽快答应或表达「这还用问」的快捷键。
example: "Can you send me the notes?" — "ofc!"

meaning: right now：「现在/此刻」。描述实时状态的高频后缀：starving rn、crying rn。
example: I can't talk rn, in the middle of a quiz.

meaning: I Swear To God：「我对天发誓」。表达极度认真或极度愤怒的加强前缀。
example: ISTG if the bus is late again I'm buying a bike.

meaning: I Miss You：「想你了」。异地朋友/情侣聊天高频缩写，加强版 imysm（so much）。
example: Saw our old photos today, imy bestie.

meaning: Happy Birthday：「生日快乐」的极简版。只发 hbd 三个字母 vs 写长文祝福，是衡量交情的网络温度计。
example: hbd! 🎂 (sent at 11:59pm, still counts)

meaning: good night：「晚安」。睡前道别缩写；对特别的人会舍得多打几个字。
example: Exhausted, gn everyone.

meaning: don't worry：「别担心/没事」。安抚专用缩写，常接 it's fine。
example: dw about the late reply, I was asleep anyway.

meaning: Best Friends Forever：「一辈子的死党」。从短信时代活到现在的友情认证最高头衔。
example: She's been my BFF since middle school.

meaning: Friends With Benefits：「有特殊关系的朋友」——比朋友多一点、又不是恋人的关系标签，situationship 的近亲。
example: They're not dating, it's a FWB situation.

meaning: Long Distance Relationship：「异地恋」。留学生圈出现频率极高的三个字母，自带时差和机票的辛酸。
example: A 15-hour time difference makes our LDR tough.

meaning: Public Display of Affection：「公共场合秀恩爱」（牵手亲吻搂抱）。「PDA 警告」是单身人士的护眼预警。
example: The couple in the library needs to tone down the PDA.

meaning: 「亲亲抱抱」：x=kiss，o=hug。信息/邮件结尾的爱意签名，《Gossip Girl》让它风靡全球。
example: See you at the party! xoxo

meaning: 「互关好友」：互相关注的网友（简称 moots）。比陌生人熟、比朋友远的当代社交关系层。
example: We've been mutuals for two years but never talked.

meaning: 「网络喷子/钓鱼者」：故意发离谱言论激怒别人取乐的人。动词 trolling=故意挑衅。应对法则：don't feed the troll。
example: Ignore him, he's just a troll fishing for reactions.

meaning: 「潜水党」：只看不发言的群成员/网友。动词 lurk=潜水。大部分网络社区 90% 都是 lurker。
example: I've been a lurker in this group for years — first time posting.

meaning: 「网络照骗/假身份」：用假照片假身份网恋或交友的人。动词用法：被 catfish 了=见面发现完全不是照片里的人。
example: Turns out her online boyfriend was a catfish using model photos.

meaning: 「标题党」：用夸张误导的标题骗点击，内容根本不是那回事。「You won't believe...」是经典开头。
example: "Student becomes millionaire overnight" — pure clickbait.

meaning: 「剧透」：提前泄露剧情关键。「spoiler alert」=剧透预警，不打预警直接剧透属于网络重罪。
example: No spoilers please, I haven't watched the finale!

meaning: 「刷剧/一口气看完」：一坐下就把整季追完的观剧方式。Netflix 时代的标准动词。
example: Binge-watched the whole season in one weekend, zero regrets.

meaning: 「有毒的」：形容充满恶意、负能量的人或环境——toxic 队友、toxic 关系、toxic 职场。中文圈的「有毒」同源。
example: Muted the team chat, it was getting too toxic.

meaning: fake Instagram：「小号」。只给密友看的 Instagram 私密小号，发真实邋遢日常；大号（rinsta）才是精装门面。
example: Her finsta is 90% crying selfies and food pics.

meaning: 「报假警袭击」：谎报恶性案件骗特警突袭别人家的恶劣违法行为，多发于直播圈。是会坐牢的犯罪，不是恶作剧。
example: The streamer got swatted live — the caller now faces charges.

meaning: 「完虐/被拿下」：owned 的手滑变体（o 打成 p），反而成了梗。被吊打、账号被黑都可以说 pwned。
example: Challenged the chess club president and got absolutely pwned.

meaning: 「卷王玩家」：把休闲游戏打出职业强度的人（打到「冒汗」）。形容词 sweaty=太拼了。半嘲讽半佩服。
example: It's a casual lobby and he's building like a sweat.

meaning: 「用力过猛的人」：在不值得拼命的场合拼尽全力，胜负欲溢出屏幕。和 sweat 近义，嘲讽度更高。
example: Bro brought a spreadsheet to game night — what a tryhard.

meaning: 「炸鱼小号」：高手注册新账号去虐新手（蓝精灵 Smurf 是最早干这事的玩家 ID）。Smurfing 在多数游戏里是违规行为。
example: No way he's new — that's a smurf account for sure.

meaning: 「氛围检查」：随机抽查某人/某场合的状态对不对劲。pass the vibe check=气场合格；fail 了就快跑。
example: New café passed the vibe check: good music, free wifi.

meaning: 「怒退」：被气到摔门退出游戏/对话/群聊。配砸键盘画面食用，每个玩家都有过的瞬间。
example: Lost to the same boss 12 times and rage quit the game.

meaning: 「带飞」：一个人扛起整个团队赢下比赛。「被 carry」=躺赢。也用于小组作业：she carried the project。
example: She carried the group project while we contributed vibes.

meaning: 「送人头」：游戏里反复送死、白给对面经济。喂饱了敌人坑了队友，feeding 是团队游戏头号罪名。
example: Our jungler kept feeding, 0-9 in ten minutes.

meaning: 「葬送好局」：明明优势巨大却作死输掉。「don't throw」=别浪。体育和电竞通用。
example: We were up 20 points and still threw the game.

meaning: 「蹲点/苟着」：守在一个位置不动等人送上门的打法。射击游戏里最招恨的战术，骂人 camper 比骂菜更狠。
example: He's been camping that corner the entire match.

meaning: 「出生点/刷新」：游戏角色或物品的生成。respawn=死后重生；spawn point=出生点。已泛化成「凭空出现」的动词。
example: I died and respawned right next to the boss. Great.

meaning: 「增强」：游戏更新让某角色/装备变强（反义词 nerf）。也作形容词=肌肉发达。「这波是加 buff」已进中文圈。
example: They buffed my main character — time to rank up.

meaning: 「削弱」：游戏更新把过强的东西砍弱（源自 NERF 软弹枪——把真枪变玩具）。「被砍了一刀」的国际通用语。
example: My favorite weapon got nerfed into uselessness.

meaning: 「版本答案」：当前环境下最优的打法/配置（Most Effective Tactics Available）。「版本之子」=meta 宠儿；off-meta=非主流玩法。
example: That strategy is so meta right now, everyone copies it.

meaning: Damage Per Second：「秒伤/输出位」。MMO 三大职责之一（坦克/治疗/输出），也指输出数值本身。
example: Our DPS is too low to beat this raid boss.

meaning: 「坦克/抗伤位」：冲在最前面吸收伤害保护队友的角色。动词用法：tank the damage=硬扛。
example: I'll tank the boss, you focus on healing.

meaning: 「奶妈/治疗位」：负责给队友回血的角色。「奶不动了」的国际版：healer can't outheal stupid。
example: Protect the healer or we all die.

meaning: 「仇恨值」：怪物攻击目标的优先级。pull aggro=把怪引到自己身上。已泛化为「招惹」：别拉仇恨。
example: The mage pulled aggro and got deleted instantly.

meaning: 「肝/刷」：重复枯燥的劳动换取进度——刷级、刷题、打工都是 grind。「on the grind」=在奋斗的路上。
example: Spent the whole weekend grinding for the exam.

meaning: 「刷资源」：反复获取金币/经验/素材。farming 比 grind 更侧重收割产出，中文圈的「刷本」「打野」同义。
example: I need to farm gold before the weapon banner drops.

meaning: 「战利品/掉落」：打怪开箱获得的奖励。loot box=开箱抽奖；「这波 loot 血赚」。
example: The boss dropped legendary loot — best run ever.

meaning: Random Number Generator：「随机数/运气成分」。「RNG 游戏」=看脸游戏；rngesus（RNG+Jesus）=玄学之神。
example: Lost three rounds to pure RNG, not skill.

meaning: Free To Play：「免费游玩/零氪玩家」。f2p btw=零氪还这么强的凡尔赛宣言。与 p2w 相对。
example: He's f2p and still beat every paying player.

meaning: Pay To Win：「氪金变强」的游戏模式——花钱直接买战力。玩家圈最大差评标签之一。
example: Uninstalled after realizing the game is pure p2w.

meaning: Downloadable Content：「付费扩展内容」。本体之外追加购买的剧情/皮肤。「把结局做成 DLC」是玩家最大怨念。
example: The base game is fine but all the good maps are DLC.

meaning: Twitch 大笑表情：西班牙喜剧演员狂笑脸。kek 本是魔兽里部落视角的「lol」。弹幕刷 KEKW=笑疯了。
example: Streamer walked into the glass door — chat spammed KEKW.

meaning: Twitch 冒汗青蛙表情（monkaS）：紧张、害怕、捏一把汗的时刻。弹幕刷 monkaS=前方高能好慌。
example: One HP left against the boss — monkaS moment.

meaning: Twitch 悲伤青蛙表情：难过但又有点好笑的丧。「Sadge」=唉，可惜了。
example: Stream ended right before the final round. Sadge.

meaning: Twitch 夸智商表情（五倍大额头）：形容操作或决策聪明绝顶。反义词 3Head=憨憨。
example: Saving the ultimate for the exact right moment — 5Head play.

meaning: 「被钓鱼/被骗到了」：源自 Twitch 表情 Jebaited。完美上当的瞬间，钓鱼成功者的胜利宣言。
example: The fake door in the map gets everyone jebaited.

meaning: mad + balding：「气到脱发」。嘲讽人破防暴怒的 Twitch 黑话，比 mad 更损。
example: He's been malding in chat since he lost the bet.

meaning: 「云指挥」：观众对主播指手画脚教玩游戏（backseat gaming）。多数直播间明令禁止 backseating。
example: Chat, no backseating — let me die on my own terms.

meaning: Video On Demand：「直播回放」。「VOD 复盘」是电竞学习法；「去看 VOD」=证据都录着呢。
example: Missed the stream live, catching the VOD tonight.

meaning: 「表情/动作」：Twitch 聊天表情或游戏内跳舞动作。在对手尸体上 emote 是国际通用嘲讽礼仪。
example: He hit the victory emote before the round even ended.

meaning: 双义：①MMO 的大型团本（打 raid）；②Twitch 下播时把观众整体送去另一个直播间（raid 某主播），是社区互助文化。
example: After the stream she raided a small channel with 5k viewers.

meaning: 「快剪下来」：直播/游戏出现名场面时的呐喊——clip it and post it。「clipped」=已留证据，社死永流传。
example: He said he'd never rage quit — someone clip it.

meaning: 「卡顿/延迟」：网络不行导致画面卡、操作慢半拍。「我不是菜，是 lag」是全球玩家通用甩锅话术。
example: Sorry I died, the lag spiked to 300 ping.
